items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I didn't mention earlier, James and June were born in Westwood, New Jersey

ctx.x: Uh huh. Well, I can't think of anything else except that this has been one of the nicest interviews I've ever had with anybody, and to talk with someone as knowledgeable as you are is really something. And your two children -- and there are five children, though, yes?

Five all together. Yes. I didn't mention earlier, James and June were born in Westwood, New Jersey, where the hospital is, and of course our home there is in Hillsdale, New Jersey, and Steven was born in New York City, over at Mt. Sinai Hospital, and Ted was born in New York City, too.
